## Services

- Mystic Tarot Reading: General Question USD $20, Complex Question USD $45. Includes 5-6 card spreads, a full detailed English report, WhatsApp text-only delivery, and spread images after casting.
- Lenormand Reading: General Question USD $15, Complex Question USD $20. Includes 3-9 card spreads, a full detailed English report, WhatsApp text-only delivery, and one focused question.
- Rune Elder Futhark Norse Reading: General Question USD $15, Complex Question USD $20. Includes 3-9 rune casts, a full detailed English report, casting images after casting, and full name plus date of birth before casting.

- [Aligned Wealth Financial Planner and Journal](https://mystics-magic.pages.dev/shop/#aligned-wealth-financial-planner-and-journal): USD $22 printable financial clarity planner for money goals, aligned budgeting, journaling, and reflective planning.
- [Mystic Magic Aligned Becoming Manifestation Planner](https://mystics-magic.pages.dev/shop/#mystic-magic-aligned-becoming-manifestation-planner): USD $17 digital manifestation planner for intention setting, identity shifts, aligned action, and personal reflection.
- [Tarot Reflection Journal](https://mystics-magic.pages.dev/shop/#tarot-reflection-journal): USD $12 printable journal for questions, card pulls, insights, and follow-up reflections.
- [Question Clarity Planner](https://mystics-magic.pages.dev/shop/#question-clarity-planner): USD $8 worksheet for preparing one focused question before a reading.

## Trust And Editorial Notes

- Readings are for guidance, reflection, and possible directions.
- Readings are not guaranteed future outcomes.
- Readings are not medical, legal, or financial advice.
- All cards, runes, and energy are cleansed before every casting.
- Contact, booking, and digital product purchases are available through the website contact, booking, shop pages, and public contact profile.
- Reading reports usually arrive within 2-3 days after payment and required details are received.
- Last updated: 2026-08-31.
